limits: The temporary address makes this one destination IP local for all ports and protocols; only TCP 7000 is serviced.
No login, account, GameGuard, other-service or gameplay compatibility is tested.
ReplyWritten means the local probe handed the acknowledgement to its socket; it does not prove application-level acceptance.
Closing or killing this window abruptly may leave the volatile address until CleanupLocalHandshake.cmd or a reboot.

established: The exact game executable and TCP peer were verified on the local listener.
The complete 26-byte version request decoded as type 0x0010/action 0x0090.
The local probe wrote the six-byte version acknowledgement.
Initial client data arrived 27.001 seconds after accept, exceeding the old five-second wait.
Listener shutdown and temporary-address/route cleanup were verified.
not_established: A successful socket write alone does not establish that the client processed the acknowledgement.
No login frame was read in this version-only test.
Account authentication, GameGuard/session compatibility and gameplay remain unverified.
